pr.title: feat: do not suggest arg-list in expected callable arg
pr.body:
Heuristic: This only handles path-expr directly in the arg-list

Implemented https://github.com/rust-lang/rust-analyzer/issues/8676#issuecomment-872796029,
covering the main cases of https://github.com/rust-lang/rust-analyzer/issues/3148

Example
---
```rust
fn foo(x: Option<&str>) {
    x.map(ToOwned::to$0)
}
```

**Before this PR**

```rust
fn foo(x: Option<&str>) {
    x.map(ToOwned::to_owned(${1:&self})$0)
}
```

**After this PR**

```rust
fn foo(x: Option<&str>) {
    x.map(ToOwned::to_owned)
}
```
